name: Ormer's Revenge
summary: In the Wetlands, Ormer's Revenge begins with a demand for Sarltooth's death. Ormer Ironbraid believes the raptor led the attack that slaughtered dwarven excavators at Whelgar Excavation Site, and asks you to bring back one of its talons as proof.

sections.title: A Strike at the Pack Leader
sections.body: After the Explorer's League diggers were slaughtered at Whelgar Excavation Site, Ormer Ironbraid watched the raptors from his ridge. One beast stood larger than the rest. Sarltooth perched above the dig works, where Ormer saw it directing or leading the pack that drove the dwarves out. To Ormer, Sarltooth was more than a wild beast. He believed it had led the attack on King Magni Bronzebeard's subjects.

sections.title: Justice in the Wetlands
sections.body: Ormer demands death for the massacre. He sends you up the high paths along the excavation walls to kill Sarltooth. Bring back one of the raptor's formidable talons, and the fallen workers will be avenged. Ormer wants the marshes to know that attacks on dwarven expeditions will not go unanswered.

faq.answer: Sarltooth is a large, menacing raptor leading the pack at Whelgar Excavation Site in the Wetlands. Ormer Ironbraid believes Sarltooth directed the assault that massacred the dwarven diggers.
Sarltooth prowls an elevated path along the western wall, in the northwest corner of Whelgar Excavation Site.

faq.q: Why does Ormer want Sarltooth dead instead of just driving him away?
faq.answer: Ormer sees the raptor attack as a crime against King Magni's subjects. Dwarven workers died while doing their jobs, and Ormer believes only Sarltooth's death can redeem the memory of the fallen.
Ormer demands one of Sarltooth's talons as proof that the massive predator has been slain.

faq.q: Who were the victims at the excavation site?
faq.answer: The victims were dwarven archaeologists and laborers sent by the Explorer's League to unearth titan artifacts. Raptor packs caught them off guard and slaughtered them when they overran the dig.

faq.q: Does killing Sarltooth secure the excavation site?
faq.answer: Killing Sarltooth removes the pack's deadliest threat and brings retribution for the fallen. Raptors still crawl over the trenches, leaving the site dangerous and largely abandoned.

angles.text: As a dwarf, avenging the Explorer's League crew slaughtered at Whelgar Excavation Site honors King Magni's fallen subjects.
As a hunter, you face one of the Wetlands' apex predators. Keen tracking skills will guide you up the ridge to the pack leader.
As an Alliance member, you help secure dwarven expeditions in the marshlands and keep Alliance footholds between Ironforge and the northern lands intact.
